abandon_button: Give up and see the solutions
page_archives_intro: Replay past grids without impacting the leaderboard.
page_legal_privacy_intro: kalidoku is a self-hosted open source project. No data is shared with third parties for advertising or fingerprinting. The only cookies set are strictly necessary for operation (session, language preference).
page_legal_privacy_data_item_1: Pseudonym, e-mail (only if you create an account via Keycloak).
page_legal_privacy_data_item_2: Score, mistakes and end-of-game date for the leaderboards.
page_legal_privacy_data_item_3: IP address logged for 30 days then anonymised.
page_legal_privacy_deletion_body: You can request the deletion of your account from your profile. The pseudonym is anonymised and the e-mail is erased. Historical scores are kept so that past leaderboards stay consistent.
page_legal_privacy_host_body: Hosting: personal VPS calixteair.fr (Hetzner, Germany). No third-party analytics, no external CAPTCHA, no third-party scripts.
page_legal_cookies_intro: kalidoku only sets strictly necessary cookies. No advertising cookies, no third-party trackers.
page_legal_cookies_session_purpose: Authenticated session (random token, hash stored in DB).
page_legal_cookies_outro: No cookie is set until you sign in or change the language.

page_legal_terms_usage_body: The service is provided free of charge, as-is, without warranty. Any abuse attempt (mass scraping, API exploitation outside of the game, anti-cheat circumvention) may lead to an immediate ban.
page_legal_terms_ip_body: Station names, line names, and other quoted entities belong to their respective rights holders (RATP, SNCF, etc.). kalidoku uses them for entertainment and educational purposes, without commercial intent.
modal_rules_intro: Find the entity that satisfies both the row and column.
modal_rules_step_2: Type the name and pick a suggestion.
modal_rules_step_3: You have three mistakes allowed per grid.
error_grid_unavailable: Today's grid is unavailable. The generator may not have run yet.
